text: {"lessons":["I sold several holdings after gains, then later bought Stock C and D again; I should avoid treating a sale as proof that a stock is no longer worth owning and make each decision from current prospects and portfolio needs.","After buying Stock C and D in Period 6, I held through a sizable account decline. I should set risk limits and reassess the reasons for holding rather than letting reluctance to realize a loss decide for me.","My account moved up and down while I made few trades, so I should not confuse short-term portfolio changes with evidence that I need to act. I will trade only when a clear, pre-set rationale calls for it."]}
